description: This header file defines functions for managing and adjusting log levels dynamically within a system. It provides interfaces to retrieve, set, and automatically adjust custom log levels based on property values and system events.

methods.name: getCustomLogLevel
methods.description: Retrieves the current custom log level for a given component name, returning a default value if not set.

methods.name: setCustomLogLevel
methods.description: Sets a new log level for the specified component name.

methods.name: autoAdjustCustomLogLevel
methods.description: Configures automatic adjustment of the log level for a given component name based on property change events.
